items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: And, you know, he worked with me, too.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. I had my teeth wet in, I can't talk to you. Yes, when he first came here, he came here with Billy Mac. They had a little show and he came here from...

Which was the Mary Mac and Billy Mac. Mary Mac and Billy Mac. And I once interviewed them for Tulane University. They live right down the street. Yeah. And... Punch used to remember Punch Miller, trumpet player from the audience, he... his first records he made with the Macs, and he traveled with them in the show. Johnny Dodd said he traveled with them, too.
And I had a letter, I was just looking for it. I had a letter here from England, and they tried to get some daughter on... on him. And, you know, he worked with me, too.
